ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the linear function $y=kx+b$ ($k\ne 0$) intersects with the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{6}{x}$ ($x>0$) at points $A(m, 6)$ and $B(3, n)$. Based on the graph, directly write the range of $x$ values for which $kx+b<\frac{6}{x}$ holds.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} For the values of $x$ that satisfy $kx+b<\frac{6}{x}$, the range of $x$ is $0<x<1$ or $x>3$, \\
thus the answer is $x \in \boxed{(0,1) \cup (3, +\infty)}$.
